summary.en: One subject cut into three comic panels on three beats, each stamped with a caption; the last panel eats the frame and holds the headline.
summary.zh: 一个主体在三拍里切成三格漫画分镜，每格盖一个旁白框；最后一格吃满全屏，托住标题。

fits: One screen worth seeing whole, closer and in one detail, then a claim on it (demo, climax, claim).
notFor: Three different subjects (use quad-montage); subjects without a detail worth a close-up; quiet, editorial films (the stamps are loud).

intent.en: One subject seen whole, closer and in detail, cut in like comic panels on the beat, and the detail grows into a poster that carries the claim.
intent.zh: 同一主体看全貌、近景、细节，像漫画分格一样踩拍劈出，细节那格长成海报托住主张。

content.en: One subject (vector or high-resolution), three captions of kicker plus text (≤ 16 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters), a headline (≤ 24 chars, Chinese ≤ 10) and an optional subline.
content.zh: 一个主体（矢量或高清），三条旁白框（眉题加正文，≤ 16 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字），一个标题（≤ 24 字符、中文 ≤ 10 字），副行可选。

fits.zh: 一个值得看全貌、近景和一个细节的画面，再在上面落一句主张（演示、高潮、主张）。

notFor.zh: 三个不同主体（用 quad-montage）；没有值得特写的细节；安静的编辑风片子（盖章很响）。

en: All three panels show the same subject; different contents read as a bento layout.
Cut on the beat with a click per panel; once per film.
zh: 三格必须是同一主体；放不同内容读成 bento 排版。
踩拍、每格一声咔；一支片一次。

upstream.name: 漫画分镜切屏
upstream.summary: 分格节奏——comic-panel-split 漫画斜格劈出同一主体的三个机位，咔咔咔三格定格后末格斜边吃屏成海报
upstream.use: 把"格子"当节奏器：同主体多机位定格并列，逐格踩拍劈出；吃拍点

overlaps.note: panel-carve is the carve and the eat; three-angles adds the stamped captions and the poster with the headline
